summary: Frontend-only verification of the new DESIGNER workflow. ALL 7 spec checks PASS. (1) Designer login (designer@shreedentallab.com/password123) lands at /app showing 'My Assignments' (3 active cases). No admin stats, no revenue, no patient/dentist/pricing data leaked. Each card shows the order # (SDL-2026-0008, etc.) + a colored badge: green 'Design submitted' for SDL-2026-0008 and amber 'Awaiting your design' for the others. (2) Designer sidebar contains ONLY 'My Assignments' (single nav item with palette icon) — Dashboard/Reports/Catalog/Team/Settings/Production etc. are absent. (3) Clicking the assigned order opens /app/orders/{id} rendering the designer detail page: data-testid='designer-order-no' displays 'SDL-2026-0008' in big bold heading, the green 'Design submitted — awaiting admin review' chip is visible, sections 'Files to work on' and 'Upload your design' present; data-testid='designer-upload-input' present. No Subtotal / GST / ₹ / Update Status / Status History / Timeline / patient name / dentist name shown — fully minimal projection. (4) Upload flow verified twice — uploading a .stl file via the upload input succeeded, the file 'playwright_test_design.stl' was appended under YOUR UPLOADS list and the green 'Design submitted — awaiting admin review' chip remained. Toast shown on success. (Sanity: uploading a .txt is rejected with toast 'File type .txt not allowed' — expected backend extension whitelist behavior; not a bug.) (5) Admin login (admin@shreedentallab.com/changeme123) → /app/orders/0b608cca-... shows the green banner data-testid='design-submitted-banner' with text 'The designer has uploaded a design. Review the design file below — mark status "Design Received" if it's correct, or contact the designer to re-upload.' Admin's 'Update Status' dropdown includes the 'Design Received' option (verified via select option scan). Admin retains full visibility: patient name, pricing (₹), GST, timeline, status history, files list — all intact. (6) Designer navigated to a non-assigned order id (aaaaaaaa-...) — the page rendered ONLY the shell (no designer-order-no, no Files section, no patient/dentist info); innerText body length only ~115 chars containing just nav chrome → access correctly blocked. (7) Dentist regression: dr.sharma@example.com login → /app/orders → opening own order shows full Patient, ₹/Total, Status Timeline — dentist flow untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: DesignerOrderDetail.jsx — the upload input handler does not surface a per-file failure clearly when one of multiple files fails extension validation; a single rejected file aborts the loop silently after showing the backend toast. Low risk because single-file uploads are the norm here. Suggestion: collect successes/failures and toast a combined summary.

DesignerOrders.jsx — completed (Delivered/Cancelled) section relies on status string match against hardcoded ['Delivered','Cancelled']. If admin renames these via Status Master (custom statuses), the filter will silently miss them. Consider using a status-master flag (e.g., is_terminal) instead of string compare.
Layout.jsx NAV.designer has a single 'My Assignments' entry — good; the route to:'/app' with end:true correctly highlights only on exact match. No issues.

Designer detail isImg() check uses category==='photo' OR filename ext regex — works for clinic-uploaded photos. Make sure backend's minimal-projection for designer continues to send category & filename fields, otherwise the photo grid silently breaks. (Verified working in this run.)

Backend route /designer/orders/{id} returns 404 (or empty) for unassigned id — frontend currently shows blank shell only because data fetch quietly catches the error (api.get(...).catch(() => {})). Consider showing an explicit 'You don't have access to this order' state instead of an indefinite Spinner-then-empty so users get a real message.
